scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/protocol generate && bun run --filter "*" --if-present test
scripts.check:oss-cdn: bunx oxfmt --check scripts/verify-oss-cdn.ts scripts/verify-oss-cdn.test.ts && bunx oxlint scripts/verify-oss-cdn.ts scripts/verify-oss-cdn.test.ts
